accounts.title: JWT Account Management
accounts.editHintDescription: Leave the password field blank to keep the current password
accounts.usernameHint: 3–50 characters; letters, digits, or underscore recommended
accounts.tenantScopeHint: The account manages with an admin or operator role in the listed tenants; different tenants may have different roles. Leave empty for no management scope (regular users derive tenants from their API keys).
accounts.tenantScopeUserHint: Regular users' tenants are linked automatically via their API keys; no configuration needed here.
accounts.tenantScopeAuditorHint: Auditor is a global read-only role covering all tenants; no configuration needed here.

validation.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 6 characters
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
validation.rolesRequired: Please select at least one role
validation.departmentRequired: Please select or enter a department

messages.cannotDeleteAdmin: The default admin account cannot be deleted
messages.deleteConfirmMessage: Delete account "{username}"? This action cannot be undone!
messages.relatedImpact: Related data found: {detail}. Deleting the account will also remove them, which cannot be undone.
messages.cascadeRemedy: Deleted keys and quota configs cannot be recovered. Transfer holder first if needed.
messages.cascadePartialFailed: Some related data failed to clean up. Check the API Keys page and org-scope quota panel.

accounts.departmentHint: Select from registered departments only; click "Add department" to register a new one first (it generates a stable department ID used by Team Usage statistics).
accounts.name: Name
accounts.nameHint: Display name shown for the account owner to aid identification; leave blank to show "Unassigned".
accounts.departmentAddHint: Enter a new department name to confirm: it will be registered (with a stable department ID) and then selected for this account.
